title: Step Inside Accenture: An Evening for IT Students
description_md:
# Curious about consulting, technology, and what a career at Accenture can look like?

  

Join us at the Accenture office for an evening of presentations, networking and a beer tasting (or non-alcoholic alternative) in collaboration with ÅBEN. Throughout the evening, you will hear from Accenture consultants sharing insights on topics such as AI, presentation skills, consulting, and career development. You will also have the opportunity to meet senior profiles as well as newly graduates with different backgrounds, learn about the projects and technologies we work with, and gain first-hand insights into life and career opportunities at Accenture.

  

Beyond the presentations, there will be plenty of time to connect with fellow students and Accenture consultants in a relaxed setting. Whether you are curious about consulting, technology, student opportunities, or graduate careers, the event offers a chance to ask questions, expand your network, and explore how technology and business come together to create impact.

  

📍 Accenture Office

Bohrsgade 35, 1799 Copenhagen

🕠 Thursday, November 5th, 16:30

🎤 Inspiring talks from Accenture consultants

🤝 Networking with consultants and fellow students

🍽️ Food and refreshments included

  

# Who can apply?

This event is open to students, including both:

* Bachelor’s students

* Master’s students

To apply, please upload:

* Your CV

* A short motivation (maximum 1,000 characters)

* + We would love to learn more about you. Share an experience, project, course, student job, or initiative that you found particularly interesting and tell us what you learned from it and why it mattered to you

No prior knowledge is required.

  

If selected, you will be invited to join us for an evening of inspiring talks, great conversations, and networking with Accenture consultants and fellow students.

Spots are limited, so submit your application **before Tuesday, October 20th**.

  

We look forward to seeing you there!

**About Accenture**

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.

 Visit us at [www.accenture.com](http://www.accenture.com/)
